rules: Each benchmark has one task, one score direction and its own stack rank. Equal scores share a rank. Entirely unresolved results stay unranked. No speed tie-break is invented for case tests.

cases.name: Terminal Drawing Facts
cases.task: Render the fixed 116 terminal drawing examples and satisfy every required fact in each whole case.
cases.why: More of the fixed examples satisfy their specified drawing checks.
cases.ties: Equal pass counts share a rank. No comparable time tie-break was recorded.

cases.name: Mermaid Behaviour Tests
cases.task: Pass all assertions in each of 49 selected public family-detection and SVG naming cases.
cases.why: More of the selected observable Mermaid behaviours work through the public interface.
cases.ties: Equal pass counts share a rank. Individual assertions are not extra votes.

cases.name: Mermaid API Compatibility
cases.task: Pass the 154 selected unchanged Mermaid public API test callbacks.
cases.why: More of these specific Mermaid API contracts can be used unchanged.
cases.ties: Equal pass counts share a rank. No comparable time tie-break was recorded.

cases.name: Terminal Invalid-input Rejection
cases.task: Explicitly reject the four independently invalid terminal-source controls.
cases.why: More known-invalid sources receive the required rejection. Generic crashes and untyped failures earn no credit.
cases.ties: Equal correct-rejection counts share a rank.

timing.name: Matched-workload Rendering Time
timing.task: Complete the same fixed rendering workload in a paired run with qualified sampled outputs and reference measurements.
timing.score: Paired time ratio, lowest first, within each matched run.
timing.why: The same qualified work takes less time relative to that run’s repeated reference.
timing.ties: Equal ratios share a rank. Different pairs and workloads do not share a speed rank.
timing.scope: PNG; first-use; 3 examples; 6 balanced A0/A1/B rounds; 1 sample(s) per example and replica-round. Host source request through fresh owned fork RPC, cold engine/process startup and complete public PNG export bytes returned through RPC; Mermaid includes public SVG render plus XML serialization, Image.decode, white canvas draw and PNG encoding; native uses public renderToPng(source,pixelRatio:1) plus its durable byte bridge. Includes required in-call source/job and returned-byte bridge, hash/receipt writes, common IPC transport. Common worker module initialization, artifact verification, engine teardown, controller retention and full grading excluded. OS/filesystem caches uncontrolled; no warm renderer; display service already running. Corpus: Mermaid syntax documentation at 1fb7869866dd619168d840291c9c54b4f129758b; 3 unchanged examples. Exact source IDs and hashes are in the owning plan. Ranks use the paired normalized ratio, with the reference at 1. Median replica-round time sums actual calls, including all declared samples; control medians include both A replicas. Every planned timed return, A/A control and current complete source contract must qualify; otherwise all speed values and ranks are withheld. Grading remains bound to the recorded observer; importing runs no renderer or new output observer. Intervals describe this fixed exposed workload, not ecosystem-wide speed.
